title: Add pagination and filtering to AuditLogPage
description:
AuditLogPage renders a simple table but has no pagination or filtering. For production use with thousands of entries, these are required.

**Implementation:**
- Add cursor-based pagination (Newer/Older buttons + limit selector) following JobsPage pattern
- Add filter bar with: action type dropdown, actor text input, resource type dropdown, date range presets (1h/24h/7d/30d)
- Update `useAuditLog()` in `hooks/useAudit.ts` to accept filter/pagination params and pass as query params to `GET /api/v1/audit`
- Add column header sorting (time asc/desc, action alpha)

**Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/AuditLogPage.tsx`, `dashboard/src/hooks/useAudit.ts`
definitionOfDone: Filter bar with action, actor, and date range filters
Column sorting on at least Time column

implementationPlan.description: Update dashboard/src/hooks/useAudit.ts: Make useAuditLog accept AuditFilters but continue fetching all from /policy/audit (backend has no filter params). Apply client-side filtering after fetch: filter by eventType (array includes), actor (case-insensitive substring), resourceType (exact match), timeRange (compute cutoff ms from 1h/24h/7d/30d presets, compare entry.timestamp), search (substring match across action, actor, message, resourceType, resourceId). Apply client-side sorting by sort param (e.g. 'time-asc', 'time-desc', 'action-asc'). Return full filtered list — pagination will be handled in the page component.
implementationPlan.note: Added client-side filtering (eventType, actor, resourceType, timeRange, search) and sorting (time-asc/desc, action-asc/desc). Returns filtered array alongside original query result.

implementationPlan.description: Update dashboard/src/pages/AuditLogPage.tsx: (1) Add filter bar above table: action type Select (options derived from unique eventTypes in data), actor Input, date range preset buttons (1h/24h/7d/30d/all). (2) Add column header sorting: clickable Time and Action headers toggle sort direction. (3) Add client-side pagination: state for page/perPage (default 25), Newer/Older buttons + page indicator + perPage selector (25/50/100). (4) Slice filtered+sorted entries by page*perPage. (5) Keep existing table structure, loading/error states, ms-precision timestamps.
implementationPlan.note: Added filter bar (event type Select, actor Input, resource type Select, time range pill buttons), sortable Time/Action columns with icons, and client-side pagination with Newer/Older + per-page selector (25/50/100). Timestamps use ms precision via fractionalSecondDigits.
